notes: Probe: 'Abul-Haj' 0.894, 'Abou El Anein' 0.776, 'Abu al-Qasim' 0.675, Arabic 'أبو القاسم' 0.669, 'Abu'l-Fida' 0.668, 'Abu Dhabi' 0.451; same sentences without Abu 0.011-0.018.
